{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABcb2qEQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhF-nKw", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 83, "title": "Simplify the public MMD/glTF comparison UI around the approved visual mockup", "body": "## Problem and approved direction

The public Uka/Gene Light MMD-vs-glTF comparison now has several separate toolbars, playback widgets, status lines and technical details competing with the main visual comparison. The maintainer explicitly approved a clean minimalist light-theme redesign image in the ChatGPT conversation on 2026-11-04 and requested implementation of that concept.

**Goal:** make the two comparison viewers dominant, move lesser-used controls into a compact collapsible Details area, unify the playback timeline, and preserve all existing functional capabilities. This is a focused public UI/UX layout change, not an animation/physics/renderer rewrite.

The approved concept image is in the maintainer's ChatGPT conversation, not accessible as an image attachment from GitHub. The specification below is intentionally sufficient for autonomous implementation and review without requesting another human visual-approval gate. Conceptual model artwork, sample time, decorative stage and purple-On Physics switch are illustrative, not literal production data. Reuse the existing actual Uka and Gene Light licensed assets.

## Target layout from the approved mockup

1. **Header:** short Japanese heading (e.g. MMD / glTF アニメーション比較デモ), a small understated icon if useful, plenty of whitespace. Light gray page, white softly rounded surfaces, subtle borders/shadows, restrained violet accents, clear sans-serif typography. Avoid custom external fonts/icons/CDN dependencies.
2. **Single compact top toolbar:** Model dropdown (Uka / Gene Light), Motion dropdown (Rest / official character-specific sample / Laugh / Apology), Display dropdown for glTF Toon/PBR, independent IK toggle and Physics toggle. Controls have short accessible labels and clear checked/disabled states. Preserve the currently supported motion choices and switching logic.
3. **Dominant viewer:** two equally sized cards/regions, permanently labeled MMD and glTF, with synchronized camera. The main stage occupies most of the width/height; do not embed large diagnostic text. Keep the actual existing renderer/canvas and its two visual halves, not separate duplicated canvases or extra rendered model instances. A small non-intercepting orbit/zoom hint is appropriate.
4. **Right Details panel on wide desktop:** a tidy collapsible section labelled 詳細, housing secondary controls: camera reset, Outline switch, concise debug/IK/Physics status and diagnostics, downloads/source links, and Uka's manual Expression selector when Rest mode permits it. Each displayed control must actually function; no decorative inert buttons or invented export capability. Collapsing the pane must give width back to both viewers instead of leaving a blank sidebar. On mobile use a drawer/disclosure below the viewers rather than a permanently open side panel.
5. **Unified bottom playback timeline:** one Play/Pause action, Restart / go-to-start, elapsed/total time and a long usable time scrubber below the two viewers; Loop remains reachable either compactly here or in Details. Do not duplicate confusing Play/Pause controls between toolbar and timeline. A next-animation icon should be omitted unless genuinely implemented, labeled and testable. Preserve all current seek/pause/restart/loop behavior and 30fps shared time.
6. **Collapsed About / Credits at bottom:** retain all current Uka/Gene rights, provenance, original notices, source links, conversion notes, MMD-direct-PMX-not-native-MikuMikuDance qualification, backend licenses, source downloads and detailed limitations. The contents are reachable but not permanently occupying screen space.

## Real current implementation to modify (main fc72492e8e6cfa43b48ba1e30b59e8a06ab8bf00)

- https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/index.html — model picker, separate material/Outline row, Uka expression, crowded IK/Physics/Motion/Play/Restart/Time/Loop row, comparison panes, About & credits, and separate hidden synthetic-rig conformance UI.
- https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/style.css — desktop comparison two columns, mobile <=900px vertical stacking, ad-hoc playback layout; refactor with maintainable responsive CSS rather than another pile of overrides.
- https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/demo.ts — real model switching, status/error/Retry lifecycle.
- https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts — shared clock, renderer/camera/resize, material/Outline/Expression, IK and optional Physics. Keep runtime semantics intact; adapt DOM plumbing only as needed.
- https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md and https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-physics.md — authoritative behavior and technical limitations.

## Required behavior / guardrails

- [ ] The Model selector shows only Uka and Gene Light in the public view; preserve each model's three genuine embedded VMD clips plus Rest/manual expression mode and exactly synchronized MMD and glTF timing. Motion changes must not reload the model or recreate the renderer.
- [ ] Physics defaults **Off**, despite the concept image illustrating the switch as On. Off does not fetch/init Ammo. Preserve the independent IK toggle, the existing Physics loading/simulating/On/Off/unavailable/error states and failure-to-Off recovery. Preserve the **Gene Light Apology + IK On => Physics unavailable** restriction, with an intelligible visible reason, and keep supported combinations working.
- [ ] Preserve Toon/PBR and Outline behavior, camera sync, camera interaction, canvas bounds/readback, physics three-world ownership and teardown, original image/PMX/glTF downloads and source/attribution. A camera-reset action, if included to match the visual mockup, must restore the correct model-specific shared framing without reloading models.
- [ ] Preserve Play/Pause, Restart, fractional slider seek, looping, current/total duration, Rest/manual blink/smile, motion switching, smooth error and Retry recovery. Avoid confusing duplicate playback controls or decorative toggles.
- [ ] Loading statuses and failures must remain discoverable and screen-reader announced even when Details is collapsed; a real failure must not be hidden behind the panel. Keep keyboard focus, labels, disabled reasons, sufficient contrast, reduced-motion support and touch-friendly target sizes.
- [ ] Mobile (~390px, plus narrower 320px if feasible): vertically stacked equal-priority MMD/glTF panes; toolbar wraps cleanly; time slider is usable with touch; Details does not steal viewer width or cause horizontal overflow; no hidden/cut off controls, broken canvas gestures, or overlapping status.
- [ ] Keep the internal synthetic-rig testing harness accessible only via its existing explicit deep link, without showing synthetic model choices in the public picker or breaking rig controls. Preserve read-only diagnostics and existing browser test interfaces; when DOM selectors change, update all consumers and tests together.
- [ ] Avoid changing shaders, lighting, physics solvers, source bytes, animation timing, permissions, libraries or heavy GPU allocations merely to copy an illustrative mockup.

## Implementation / test checklist

- [ ] Build semantic, responsive primary toolbar / two-viewer stage / collapsible Details / one playback bar / collapsed credits as described. All controls remain functional and state is synchronized across changes and loading.
- [ ] Adapt tests in tests/browser/unified-demo.spec.ts, uka.spec.ts, public-physics.spec.ts and relevant motion/IK, loading and rig suites without dropping their behavioral or pixel/precision assertions.
- [ ] Add focused UI and accessibility checks (tab order, Details keyboard toggle, toggle labels, visible error/Retry, compact motion/timeline, disabled Physics reason); verify Model/Toon-PBR/Outline/IK/Physics/Expression states stay correct in both characters.
- [ ] Capture before/after test screenshots at desktop 1440x900, tablet around 900px and mobile 390x844, plus narrow 320px. Check loaded/rest/playing/long label/error/Details expanded and collapsed states. These are layout evidence, not an external subjective signoff gate. Use authentic existing models, not mockup character artwork.
- [ ] Verify Details collapse/expand, mode and motion changes and responsive resizing do not create extra renderer/canvases, refetch static model/texture resources, reset the orbit unexpectedly or leak Physics native resources.
- [ ] Run relevant focused Playwright checks while iterating, then verify npm ci, npm run build, npm run typecheck, npm test, all applicable required CI browser shards, npm run check:links and git diff --check. Preserve the CI sharding gains of Issue #81 / PR #82 and document real pass/fail/skip outcomes.
- [ ] Update minimal user-facing instructions, preserve all licensing and technical caveats, and provide an exact final PR screenshot/links for desktop and narrow/mobile layouts.

## Definition of done

At first glance, users see mostly the side-by-side MMD/glTF character comparison, a short toolbar and a coherent playback timeline. The advanced panel and credits are readily accessible but unobtrusive, every existing public capability and warning remains available, and the layout is genuinely usable on mobile. The complete necessary CI/behavior checks pass without weakening physics, animation or shader guarantees.

## Workflow
